paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.01% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+3.30%) and FTSE 100 weakest (-1.48%). Brent crude changed -3.24% to 100.18. Gold changed +0.24% to 4,196.8999. Bitcoin changed +0.32% to 83,818.3438. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.293%, a relative move of +0.72%. Among the firms tracked, BBVA (-2.69%) and Santander (-2.54%) moved the most.
